goal: 在会议茶歇时与同行有效交流,展示研究、建立初步的学术联系

n1.speaker: 同行 Dr. Kim (首尔大学)
n1.line: I noticed your name tag says you are presenting tomorrow. I am Dr. Kim. May I ask what line of research you are pursuing?
n1.lineCn: 我看到你的名牌上写着明天有报告。我是金博士。可以冒昧问一下你在做什么方向的研究吗?

grammar.name: Line of research
grammar.note: 学术社交高频搭配:line of research 指“研究方向”,比 research direction 更地道,属固定搭配。

options.text: Nice to meet you, Dr. Kim. I conduct research on second language acquisition, specifically how feedback shapes pronunciation development.
options.textCn: 幸会,金博士。我从事二语习得研究,具体关注反馈如何塑造语音发展。
options.feedback: 用 conduct research on 介绍方向,再以 specifically 收窄范围,信息密度恰到好处。

options.text: Hi. I do stuff about language learning, it is not very interesting.
options.textCn: 嗨。我做语言学习那方面的事,没什么意思。
options.feedback: stuff 加自我贬低,既没传达信息又显得缺乏热情,同行难以接话。

options.text: I am working on a project about pronunciation, but I am still a beginner so I cannot really explain it.
options.textCn: 我在做一个关于发音的项目,但我还是新手,不太讲得清楚。
options.feedback: 自称讲不清反而暴露了表达意愿的不足,学术社交需要自信地推介自己。

n2.speaker: 同行 Dr. Kim (首尔大学)
n2.line: Pronunciation development is a fascinating topic. Did your recent study draw any conclusions that surprised you?
n2.lineCn: 语音发展是个很有意思的课题。你最近的研究得出了什么出人意料的结论吗?

grammar.name: Draw a conclusion
grammar.note: 学术高频搭配:draw a conclusion 表示“得出结论”,是 reach, arrive at 的同义替换选项。

options.text: One surprising finding was that corrective feedback helped far more when delivered asynchronously, which contradicted our initial hypothesis.
options.textCn: 一个意外的发现是:异步反馈的效果远好于同步,这与我们最初的假设相悖。
options.feedback: 用 surprising finding 开头制造话题钩子,contradicted our hypothesis 学术味十足。

options.text: Our study found something interesting, but I cannot remember the details right now.
options.textCn: 我们的研究发现了有趣的东西,但我一时记不起细节了。
options.feedback: 关键时刻记不起细节,让对话戛然而止,是社交中的尴尬场景。

options.text: We concluded that timing matters a great deal; delayed feedback proved more effective than immediate correction.
options.textCn: 我们得出结论:时机至关重要;延迟反馈比即时纠正更有效。
options.feedback: 用 concluded that 引出结论,再具体到 delayed versus immediate,细节扎实。

n3.speaker: 同行 Dr. Kim (首尔大学)
n3.line: I see. For my part, I study learner motivation, so I always enjoy hearing how others frame their questions. How do you define the scope of your study?
n3.lineCn: 原来如此。我研究学习者动机,所以很乐意听别人如何构架问题。你如何界定研究范围?

grammar.name: Frame a question
grammar.note: 学术词汇搭配:frame 意为“构架、界定”,frame a question/a study 是研究讨论中的常用搭配。

options.text: Thank you for asking. The scope covers adult learners in online courses, with pronunciation measured at three points across a semester.
options.textCn: 谢谢您发问。研究范围涵盖线上课程的成人学习者,发音在学期内三个时间点测量。
options.feedback: 主动回应加时间点细节 (three points across a semester),一下子把话题打开了。

options.text: Honestly, my scope is whatever my supervisor says it is.
options.textCn: 老实说,我的范围是导师说了算。
options.feedback: 把责任推给导师,显得缺乏自主性,学术社交中是大忌。

options.text: The study focuses on adults taking online courses, and we sampled their pronunciation three times over one term.
options.textCn: 研究聚焦线上课程成人学员,我们在一学期内三次采样其发音。
options.feedback: focus on 加三次采样细节,表述专业,对方可以继续追问。

n4.speaker: 同行 Dr. Lopez (马德里大学,加入对话)
n4.line: Forgive me for interrupting, but I could not help overhearing the word "feedback". I work on corrective feedback in Spanish. Do you see potential for collaboration?
n4.lineCn: 请原谅我插话,但我无意中听到“反馈”一词。我研究西班牙语中的纠正性反馈。你觉得有合作可能吗?

grammar.name: Could not help overhearing
grammar.note: could not help + doing 表示“忍不住做某事”,学术社交中插入谈话的礼貌托辞。

options.text: I would be delighted. Our frameworks overlap considerably, and a cross-linguistic comparison would strengthen both our arguments considerably.
options.textCn: 我很乐意。我们的研究框架高度重叠,跨语言对比将大大增强双方的论证。
options.feedback: delighted 表热情,overlap considerably 给出合作基础,顺带点出双赢价值。

options.text: Maybe, if I have time. I am quite busy this year.
options.textCn: 也许吧,如果我有时间。我今年挺忙的。
options.feedback: 热情不足、条件含糊,合作信号完全丢失,对方只能寒暄收场。

options.text: That sounds promising. Our data sets would complement each other, and a joint paper would certainly reach a wider audience.
options.textCn: 听起来很有前景。我们的数据集可以互补,合著论文也必然触达更广的读者。
options.feedback: complement、reach a wider audience 精准描述合作收益,专业又热忱。

n5.speaker: 同行 Dr. Kim (首尔大学)
n5.line: No rush. Perhaps you could share the main takeaway of your paper, even in broad strokes?
n5.lineCn: 不急。也许你能大致说一下论文的主要结论,哪怕只是梗概?

grammar.name: In broad strokes
grammar.note: 固定短语 in broad strokes 意为“粗略地、大体上”,是社交场合请对方概括时的缓和说法。

options.text: In broad strokes, delayed feedback proved superior, which aligns with a growing body of evidence in the field.
options.textCn: 大体上说,延迟反馈效果更优,这与该领域日益增多的证据相吻合。
options.feedback: 用 in broad strokes 接住对方,再以 a growing body of evidence 引经据典,气氛回暖。

options.text: I really think you should read my paper instead of asking me to summarise it.
options.textCn: 你真该去读我的论文,而不是让我来总结。
options.feedback: 不耐烦地推给对方,破坏茶歇轻松氛围,也断送了潜在人脉。

options.text: To give you the gist, timing beat frequency: when feedback was delayed, accuracy rose markedly, and that is our core claim.
options.textCn: 给你个要点:时机胜过频率。反馈延迟时准确率显著上升,这就是我们的核心主张。
options.feedback: give you the gist 加核心主张收尾,概括专业又不失亲和。

n6.speaker: 同行 Dr. Lopez (马德里大学)
n6.line: Splendid. Have your findings appeared in any peer-reviewed journals, and would you be open to exchanging drafts?
n6.lineCn: 太好了。你的研究发表过同行评审期刊吗?你愿意互相交换初稿吗?

grammar.name: Peer-reviewed journal
grammar.note: 学术必备搭配:peer-reviewed (同行评审) + journal (期刊),描述发表渠道时的标准组合。

options.text: One paper is under review at a peer-reviewed journal, and I would be glad to exchange drafts. I will email you my working paper this week.
options.textCn: 有一篇正送同行评审期刊审稿,我非常乐意交换初稿,本周就把工作论文发给你。
options.feedback: 发表状态如实告知加明确行动 (email working paper),合作推进得干净利落。

options.text: I have not published anything yet, and I am not comfortable sharing drafts, sorry.
options.textCn: 我还没发表过任何东西,也不太愿意分享初稿,抱歉。
options.feedback: 不发表不可耻,但拒绝分享又无替代方案,等于亲手关上了合作的门。

options.text: It is under review at the moment; once the process concludes, I would welcome your feedback on the revised version.
options.textCn: 目前正处审稿中;流程结束后,我很欢迎你对修订稿提出意见。
options.feedback: 状态清楚、姿态开放,还设定了后续接触点,交流空间持续打开。

n7.speaker: 同行 Dr. Kim (首尔大学)
n7.line: The plenary session resumes in five minutes. Before we go, could we exchange contact details, and would you join us for dinner tonight?
n7.lineCn: 主旨报告五分钟后就开始了。走之前,我们能交换联系方式吗?今晚愿意一起吃饭吗?

grammar.name: Exchange contact details
grammar.note: 会议社交收尾标配:exchange contact details (交换联系方式) 后常跟着具体邀约,完成破冰闭环。

options.text: Absolutely, I would love to. Here is my card; my email is on the back, and I look forward to continuing our conversation over dinner.
options.textCn: 当然,我很乐意。这是我的名片,邮箱在背面,期待晚宴上继续我们的交谈。
options.feedback: 即时行动 (递名片) 加明确回应,社交闭环完成,两位同行都对你印象深刻。

options.text: I am not sure, maybe, let me think about it, I will probably be tired.
options.textCn: 不确定,也许吧,我想想,我可能会累。
options.feedback: 含糊推诿让邀约落地失败,人脉维系的机会就此溜走。

options.text: Certainly. Dinner sounds wonderful, and it would give us a chance to discuss the collaboration in more depth.
options.textCn: 当然。晚餐听起来很棒,正好让我们有机会更深入地讨论合作。
options.feedback: 应约并顺势把话题引向合作深化,是学术社交的理想收尾。

n8.speaker: 同行 Dr. Kim (首尔大学)
n8.line: Wonderful. I also run a small research seminar every month; would you be interested in presenting your work there this autumn?
n8.lineCn: 太好了。我每月还主持一个小型研究研讨会,你有兴趣今年秋天去讲讲你的研究吗?

grammar.name: Run a seminar
grammar.note: 学术动词搭配:run 可表示“主持、运营”活动,run a seminar/workshop 是常见搭配。

options.text: I would be honoured. Presenting at your seminar would also give us a natural point to revisit our joint paper after dinner.
options.textCn: 这是我的荣幸。在你的研讨会上报告,也为我们晚宴后重提合著论文提供了自然的契机。
options.feedback: honoured 得体地表态,还巧妙把两次邀约连成一条线,人脉经营高手。

options.text: I will try to make time, but no promises, because I have a lot of teaching this term.
options.textCn: 我尽量挤出时间,但别抱太大希望,这学期我课很多。
options.feedback: 反复用忙碌当挡箭牌,对方的热忱被一再浇灭,联系只能停留在客套。

options.text: That is very kind of you. I would be glad to present, and I could also bring our latest data for discussion.
options.textCn: 您太客气了。我很乐意去做报告,还可以带上我们的最新数据供讨论。
options.feedback: 欣然应约且主动加码 (bring latest data),把机会变成了实质产出。

success.speaker: 同行 Dr. Kim (首尔大学)
success.line: Excellent! It has been a genuine pleasure. I will send you the seminar details this evening, and I look forward to working with you.
success.lineCn: 太棒了!认识你真是件愉快的事。今晚我把研讨会详情发给你,期待与你共事。

grammar.name: It has been a genuine pleasure
grammar.note: 社交收束金句:genuine pleasure 比 nice to meet you 更能传达真诚,配合 I look forward to 收尾。

fail1.speaker: 同行 Dr. Kim (首尔大学)
fail1.line: I see. Well, it was nice meeting you. I hope the rest of the conference treats you well.
fail1.lineCn: 明白了。那,很高兴认识你。祝你在会议余下的时间一切顺利。

grammar.name: I see
grammar.note: I see 是表示“知道了、理解”的简洁回应,但若出现在对话结尾,往往意味着话题已无路可走。

fail2.speaker: 同行 Dr. Lopez (马德里大学)
fail2.line: Thank you for the chat. Do feel free to reach out should your situation change. I must be off to the next session.
fail2.lineCn: 谢谢你的交谈。如果情况有变,请随时联系我。我得去赶下一场报告了。

grammar.name: Do feel free to reach out
grammar.note: should 倒装条件句 (should your situation change) 是正式英语中的高雅表达,比 if 从句更书面。
